segments.expected: "I said no." Pru took the book. She held it in both capped hands against her chest, the way Loveday Hosken had held a jar. "I'd have been Ivey's catcher. I'd have been good. I'd have been the girl from Meridian on Ivey's crew who used to be Rowan's cord." She looked at Kiva. "I'm on a sheet. My own, with my name on the hem in ink. I'm going back to the Crooked Line and I'm going to find three people who've never heard of the Pit, and I'm going to catch for them, and nobody's going to say whose I was." She held the book tighter. "I'm not grateful to anybody. I'm only good. I'd like that written in the book, on the first page I write on."
